_about: KP14 oracle-only ROOM screen, 2026-10-07. Each point is vyg25 (var-kp_vy-vyg25-v4: three types 0.02/0.07/0.14, gamma_v 2.5, bv_comp 1.2, kappa_y 0.35) with ONE parameter changed. Only the population ceilings are measured (run_oracle.py, no estimators), seeds 0 and 1, so nothing here is a gap and nothing goes in RESULTS.md: it ranks candidate economies by room_s, the part of room that is nonlinear in the ranks GIVEN the state, which is what converts to a fair gap in KP14 (docs/REDUCED_FORM.md). Feasibility (rho_ty > 0, const_ty > 0, A0 finite) was checked from parameters_kp14.py before submission; gamma_z -0.60 FAILS it (rho_ty min -0.017, the K5 wall), -0.45 is the edge (+0.013).

points.why: price of the IST shock z, which only growth options load on: the premium spread between assets in place and options, i.e. the price of the within-type option-share curvature
the same knob the other way: a sign check on gamma_z
price of the common productivity shock x (0.69 in KP14): scales every premium, options more than assets
dispersion of project arrival rates across firms (2.0): widens the within-type spread of the option share
project returns to scale (0.85): alpha/(1-alpha) 5.67 -> 3.00, flattens the option value's convexity
the clean price-of-y point: vyg30k70 moved gamma_v AND kappa_y; this is gamma_v 3.0 at kappa_y 0.35
